name: Quality of Life
description: Ten conveniences, each with its own setting and none on until you turn it on: field moves without a Pokemon that knows them, Repel renewal, EXP from catches, PC in the start menu, running at bike speed while B is held, an EXP rate from x0.5 to x4, an Exp. Share that pays the whole party, type effectiveness hints, stat stages and a weather indicator.
